patterns.note: Asymmetrical hero section featuring a massive, overlapping brand mark on the left that acts as a background element, balanced by a concise headline and supporting text on the right.
A sophisticated pairing of an elegant, high-contrast serif font for display headings and a clean, modern sans-serif for body text and smaller labels, creating a balance of classic and contemporary.
A strictly monochromatic palette of off-white backgrounds and deep charcoal/black text, with no prominent accent colors, reinforcing a premium and minimal aesthetic.
The oversized 'OGAKI' logo in the hero section employs a subtle parallax effect, scrolling slower than the foreground content to create a sense of depth as the user scrolls down the page.
Full-width sections are used to showcase client logos and case studies, often featuring a grid layout with consistent spacing and typography for each item.

technique_notes: Implement a large, high-contrast brand mark as a background element in the hero section that scrolls at a slower rate than the foreground content, creating a parallax depth effect.
Utilize a sticky header that maintains its position at the top of the viewport after initial scroll, without significant transformation in size or background.

Employ scroll-triggered animations to reveal content sections as they enter the viewport, typically with a subtle fade-in and slight upward translation, enhancing engagement as the user progresses down the page.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, elegant serif headings (~3-4x body) are paired with clean, legible sans-serif body text and small, uppercase sans-serif labels for a refined, editorial feel.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners are consistently applied to all elements, including buttons, images, and containers, contributing to a crisp and modern aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy spacing is used between major sections and within the hero, creating a sense of luxury and allowing elements to breathe, while content grids maintain a balanced density.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is the bold, oversized brand mark in the hero section, which acts as a dynamic background element with a parallax scroll effect. This, combined with the elegant serif typography and strictly monochromatic palette, elevates the design beyond a typical agency site into a realm of high-end editorial sophistication.
